entities.name: Louis Anton of Pfalz-Neuburg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ludwig Anton von Pfalz-Neuburg, also known as Ludwig Anton von Rhein zu Neuburg, served as Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights from 1685 and as the Prince-Bishop of Worms from 1691 until his death in 1694.
